description: Rec 3: Genesis is a 2012 Spanish action horror film directed and co-written by Paco Plaza. The film, which is the third installment in the Rec series, eschews the found-footage format of its predecessors and occurs concurrently as the first film. Rec 3: Genesis follows two newlyweds who struggle to reunite with each other after the viral zombie outbreak ruins their wedding reception and infects their families.
